question: In a certain code language, “Sun is hot” is written as “ﬁ lat muk”, “milk is sour” is written as “muk ti mu” and “milk makes sour” is written as “ti mu fa”. What is the code for “is” in that code language?
solution:
According to given information:-

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/af86d15e993dc929b4ea64418de5454eba141d25adf6bdc8f1a85c03b9b5baee.png]
